objects.name: China-nexus UAT-11587 targets government and policy organizations across Asia with Antino backdoor
objects.description: Cisco Talos uncovered a cluster of activity we track as UAT-11587 targeting government and policy organizations across Asia, including in Taiwan, India, the Philippines, and Cambodia, to deliver a previously undocumented backdoor referred to as “Antino” in developer artifacts.
